papers.title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
papers.abstract: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.
papers.summary_zh: 大语言模型被用于从无法索引的大规模文档集中检索信息，但涉及专业语言或科学知识时任务困难。作者用维基百科游戏测试模型，基于OpenAlex构建本地维基百科和论文引用大图，比较句嵌入模型与LLM在五种语言和五个学术数据集上的导航能力，并与人类和TF-IDF基准对比。结果显示没有模型显著超越人类，最佳模型（GPT-o3 mini、GPT-4o、QwQ:32B、DeepSeek-R1:70B）仅达到相当水平，且性能随语言和主题变化，对实践者有重要启示。
papers.summary_en: Language models are increasingly used for information retrieval from document collections too large to index, but this is difficult when specialist knowledge is required. The authors used the Wikipedia Game to test models by building large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and paper citations from OpenAlex, comparing sentence embedding models and LLMs across five languages and five academic datasets against human and TF-IDF benchmarks. No model significantly outperformed humans, though the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success, with performance varying across languages and topics, offering implications for practitioners.
highlights_zh: 构建本地维基与引用大图免API
最佳模型仅与人类表现相当
跨语言跨领域性能差异显著

papers.title: Hide and Seek: HIDE Concepts to SEEK explanations for black box models
papers.abstract: Interpreting machine learning model predictions is a central challenge, particularly for black-box vision models. Concept-based attribution methods interpret models using human-understandable concepts. Existing concept-based methods can only interpret classification and regression models. They require access to model weights or large concept-annotated datasets, and most methods cannot provide image-level attribution. We propose Hide and Seek (HnS), a new method for concept-level attribution that does not require access to model weights or labeled concept datasets. HnS can interpret a wide range of vision models. Given a concept and image set, HnS retrieves concept-aligned images using a vision-language model, localizes the concept within each image, masks the localized region, and measures attribution from the change in the black-box model's output between the original and masked images. This enables faithful attribution by directly measuring the model's behavior and supporting local attributions. We validated HnS on CelebA and COCO-Stuff. Compared to existing methods, HnS showed better agreement with ground-truth attributions. We demonstrated the applicability of HnS on diverse tasks, including image captioning and satellite image segmentation, where no existing concept attribution method can be used. We provided our anonymous code in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh: 现有概念归因方法仅能解释分类和回归模型，且需访问模型权重或大量概念标注数据，多数无法提供图像级归因。本文提出Hide and Seek（HnS），利用视觉语言模型检索概念对齐图像、定位并掩码概念区域，通过比较黑盒模型输出变化实现无需权重和标注数据的概念级归因。在CelebA和COCO-Stuff上，HnS比现有方法更符合真实归因，并成功应用于图像描述和卫星图像分割等新任务。
papers.summary_en: Existing concept-based attribution methods can only interpret classification and regression models, require access to model weights or large concept-annotated datasets, and mostly cannot provide image-level attribution. We propose Hide and Seek (HnS), which uses a vision-language model to retrieve concept-aligned images, localize and mask the concept region, and measure attribution from the change in the black-box model's output, requiring neither weights nor labeled concept data. On CelebA and COCO-Stuff, HnS agrees better with ground-truth attributions than existing methods and enables applications like image captioning and satellite image segmentation where no prior concept attribution method applies.
highlights_zh: 无需模型权重和概念标注数据
归因结果更符合真实标注
可扩展至图像描述与分割任务

papers.title: Constructive Bounds for the Topological Expressivity of Neural Networks
papers.abstract: The expressivity of a neural network $Φ$ describes the class of functions that a network can express. The term topological expressivity refers to a family of measures particularly suited to understand binary classification and is often formulated in terms of the Betti numbers of a decision boundary $β(Φ^{-1}(0))$. Despite its popularity, this measure is not as useful for regression and other problems that do not involve a decision boundary. Instead, we propose to study topological expressivity in terms of the Betti numbers of the output of a neural network $β(Φ(X))$. We formally prove that a ReLU network with architecture $(d,\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d } β_k(3k+2),\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d}β_k(k+1))$ can express spaces homotopy equivalent to wedge sums of spheres with arbitrary Betti numbers. This gives upper bounds for any arbitrary connected ($β_0=1$) sequence of Betti numbers, but by constructing spaces homotopy equivalent to products of $N$ spheres of dimension $d_1,...,d_N$ we achieve much better bounds $(\sum\limits_{n=1} d_n, 3\sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + 2N, \sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + N) $ for Betti numbers given by $\prod_n (1+x^{d_n})$. Finally we conjecture a much stronger tight bound which gives the architectural bound $(d,d+1,d+1)$ for a space homeomorphic to the sphere.
papers.summary_zh: 拓扑表达性常用决策边界的Betti数衡量，但不适用于回归等无边界问题。本文改为研究网络输出空间的Betti数，并构造性地证明ReLU网络可表达任意Betti数的球楔和及球积空间。结果给出了拓扑表达性的上界，并猜想球同胚空间的紧致架构界为(d,d+1,d+1)。
papers.summary_en: Topological expressivity is often measured via Betti numbers of decision boundaries, which is unsuitable for regression and other problems without a boundary. This work instead studies Betti numbers of the network output and constructively proves that ReLU networks can express wedge sums and products of spheres with arbitrary Betti numbers. The results provide upper bounds on topological expressivity and conjecture a tight architectural bound (d,d+1,d+1) for spaces homeomorphic to spheres.
highlights_zh: 以输出空间Betti数替代决策边界
球积构造给出更优上界
猜想球同胚的紧致架构界
highlights_en: Uses output Betti numbers instead of decision boundaries
Sphere products yield tighter upper bounds

papers.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
papers.abstract: Capability evaluations aim to surface dangerous model behaviors before deployment, but their reliability depends on the assumption that hidden capabilities can be elicited. We show this assumption does not hold under adversarial conditions by constructing backdoor attacks that embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights, decrypting and executing them only upon receiving a secret trigger. Using digital lockers, these hidden circuits remain provably hard to elicit and interpret under cryptographic assumptions, even given full access to model weights, extending prior work from hiding fixed strings to arbitrary computations. We implement our proof of concept constructions in PyTorch and evaluate elicitation through fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient-based trigger search, and latent adversarial training on a small chemical reaction prediction task - a proxy for CBRN-relevant capabilities. Our results demonstrate resistance to these methods and, together with our cryptographic guarantees, reveal a limit of elicitation-based capability audits. We release our models to support the improvement of defenses.
papers.summary_zh: 能力评估依赖隐藏能力可被激发这一假设，但该假设在对抗条件下可能不成立。作者利用数字储物柜将加密神经网络嵌入宿主模型权重，仅在收到秘密触发器时解密执行，从而证明隐藏电路在密码学假设下难以被激发和解释。在化学反应用例上，该方法抵抗微调、权重加噪、梯度触发器搜索和潜在对抗训练，揭示了基于激发的审计存在根本局限。
papers.summary_en: Capability evaluations assume hidden capabilities can be elicited, but this assumption may fail under adversarial conditions. The authors embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights using digital lockers, decrypting and executing them only upon a secret trigger, proving hidden circuits are hard to elicit and interpret under cryptographic assumptions. On a chemical reaction prediction proxy task, the approach resists fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient-based trigger search, and latent adversarial training, revealing a fundamental limit of elicitation-based capability audits.
highlights_zh: 加密网络嵌入权重，密码学保证难激发
抵抗微调、加噪、触发器搜索与对抗训练
揭示能力审计局限，发布模型促防御
highlights_en: Encrypted nets in weights, cryptographically hard to elicit
Resists fine-tuning, noising, trigger search, adversarial training
Reveals audit limits; releases models for defenses

papers.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.
papers.summary_zh: 递归自我改进旨在将交互经验转化为持久提升，但外部反馈成本高且世界模型预测随策略演化可能失准。RSI-Anything基于JEPA-Anything构建领域通用框架，用预测世界模型指导动作与学习数据选择，并通过组件与兼容性检查保留更新后的策略-模型对。在代码修复、GUI、实验室规划、反应优化及免疫科学等任务中取得显著提升，验证了预测世界模型与系统更新保留实现跨环境递归改进的可行性。
papers.summary_en: Recursive self-improvement aims to turn interaction experience into persistent gains, but external feedback is costly and world-model predictions can become unreliable as policies evolve. RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything, uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection, with component and compatibility checks governing retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across code repair, GUI, lab planning, reaction optimization, and immune-science tasks, it achieves substantial gains, showing that predictive world models plus retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.
highlights_zh: 预测世界模型引导动作与数据选择
代码修复成功率26.3%升至31.2%
跨领域通用但依赖模型可靠性

papers.title: When VLMs Destroy What They Know: Spatial Representations Fall Below Lexical Priors
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly analyze and reason about images, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations faithfully encode the structured relations required for such reasoning. We introduce EICS (Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability), a metric for testing whether representations consistently encode concepts under controlled one-concept interventions, and CASP-VL (Causally controlled Spatial Perturbations for Vision-Language models), a benchmark of causally controlled spatial perturbations derived from Visual Genome scene graphs. Across multiple VLM architectures, we find that spatial relations are represented substantially less faithfully than lexical information, even when the same models score well above chance on compositional benchmarks. Further analysis shows that the relation is identifiable at the predicate's own tokens but is lost when the sentence is aggregated into a global representation, whether through the (EOS) token or by mean pooling. These findings reveal a systematic failure invisible to output-based evaluation: VLMs do not preserve, in the representation used downstream, relational information that is present in their own input.
papers.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型虽能分析图像，但其内部表示是否忠实编码结构化关系尚不明确。作者提出EICS度量与CASP-VL基准，通过因果控制的空间扰动测试表示的概念稳定性。结果显示空间关系编码远弱于词汇信息，且关系信息在聚合为全局表示时丢失，揭示了输出评估无法发现的系统性缺陷。
papers.summary_en: Although VLMs analyze images well, it is unclear whether their internal representations faithfully encode structured relations. The authors introduce EICS and the CASP-VL benchmark of causally controlled spatial perturbations to test concept stability under one-concept interventions. They find spatial relations are encoded far less faithfully than lexical information and are lost when aggregated into global representations, revealing a systematic failure invisible to output-based evaluation.
highlights_zh: EICS度量与CASP-VL因果扰动基准
空间关系编码显著弱于词汇先验
揭示输出评估无法发现的表示缺陷

papers.title: Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study physically grounded articulated 3D asset generation---moving the goal from reproducing how objects look to capturing how they move and function. Inspired by the literature on procedural and agentic generation, we present Artisan, a system that extends the latest method Articraft by introducing a multi-agent pipeline with physical simulation feedback, enabling comprehensive attributes beyond geometry, appearance, and physically plausible articulation, such as collision-free motion, stability under gravity, and accurate mass and material properties. Furthermore, we construct a unified benchmark spanning four key aspects: spatial fidelity, physical plausibility, downstream task performance, and overall quality. The benchmark encompasses 100 reference assets from ArtVIP and LightWheel, 50 stability prompts, and 50 ABO objects with reference masses, with protocols evaluating various metrics. Through extensive evaluation of more than 10 representative models, Artisan achieves competitive spatial fidelity while attaining the lowest collision rates and highest stability rates among the evaluated methods. Together, our system and benchmark establish insights for advancing 3D generation towards physically plausible, functionally usable assets.
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究物理落地的铰接3D资产生成，目标从复现物体外观转向捕捉其运动与功能。受程序化与智能体生成文献启发，提出Artisan系统，在Articraft基础上引入带物理仿真反馈的多智能体流水线，实现无碰撞运动、重力稳定性及准确质量与材质等属性，并构建涵盖空间保真度、物理合理性、下游任务性能和整体质量的统一基准。在10余个代表性模型上的评估表明，Artisan在保持有竞争力的空间保真度同时取得最低碰撞率和最高稳定率，为推进物理合理、功能可用的3D生成提供系统与基准洞见。
papers.summary_en: This paper studies physically grounded articulated 3D asset generation, shifting the goal from reproducing how objects look to capturing how they move and function. Inspired by procedural and agentic generation literature, it presents Artisan, which extends Articraft with a multi-agent pipeline featuring physical simulation feedback to achieve collision-free motion, stability under gravity, and accurate mass and material properties, alongside a unified benchmark covering spatial fidelity, physical plausibility, downstream task performance, and overall quality. Evaluations of over 10 representative models show Artisan attains competitive spatial fidelity with the lowest collision rates and highest stability rates, offering insights for advancing 3D generation toward physically plausible, functionally usable assets.
highlights_zh: 多智能体+物理仿真反馈流水线
最低碰撞率与最高稳定率
推动功能可用的3D资产生成

papers.title: Splat2Act: From Captured Scenes to Personalized VLA Manipulation
papers.abstract: A user who brings a generalist manipulation policy into their home or office wants it to pick up their objects from their shelves, counters, and tables. Yet even a strong generalist like $π_{0.5}$ achieves 0% pickup success in our captured deployment scenes without adaptation, and collecting real demonstrations in every user's environment is prohibitively expensive. We present Splat2Act, an automated real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that personalizes a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a specific scene and object set using only a handheld phone scan and images of the user's objects. Unlike prior real-to-sim work that reconstructs individual tabletops, Splat2Act operates on building-scale indoor environments: it builds a photorealistic digital twin with 3D Gaussian Splatting and collision geometry, automatically discovers tabletop and non-tabletop receptacles, constructs feasible pickup tasks, and generates successful demonstrations with a privileged simulation oracle, with only scene and object capture required from a human. Applied to 101 scanned campus environments with a median navigable area of 104.87 m$^2$ and 7 receptacles, the pipeline yields 852 receptacles and over 68,000 pickup demonstrations. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ in two stages: Stage 1 adapts to hundreds of public object assets, drawn either from the deployment scene alone or from all 101 scenes; Stage 2 personalizes to the user's own objects on the deployment scene's receptacles. Our strongest personalized policy reaches 62.5% aggregate pickup success in the target scene. Deployed on a real Stretch 3, the same policy achieves 63.9% success on a 12-task subset, closely tracking its 66.7% simulated success on those tasks. These results suggest that automated real-to-sim-to-real training can personalize VLA manipulation policies using only simulation-oracle data.
papers.summary_zh: 通用VLA策略（如π0.5）在用户真实场景中零样本拾取成功率为0%，而为每个环境采集真实演示代价高昂。Splat2Act提出自动化real-to-sim-to-real流水线，仅凭手机扫描和物体图像，用3D高斯泼溅构建建筑级数字孪生、自动发现容器并借助特权仿真oracle生成演示，再分两阶段微调π0.5。在101个校园场景生成超6.8万条演示，个性化策略在目标场景达62.5%成功率，真机Stretch 3上12任务子集达63.9%，表明仅用仿真oracle数据即可个性化VLA操作策略。
papers.summary_en: Generalist VLA policies like π0.5 achieve 0% pickup success in captured deployment scenes without adaptation, while collecting real demonstrations per environment is prohibitively expensive. Splat2Act is an automated real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that, using only a handheld phone scan and object images, builds building-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting digital twins with collision geometry, discovers receptacles, constructs pickup tasks, and generates demonstrations via a privileged simulation oracle to fine-tune π0.5 in two stages. Across 101 scanned campus scenes it yields 852 receptacles and over 68,000 demonstrations, reaching 62.5% aggregate pickup success in the target scene and 63.9% on a 12-task subset on a real Stretch 3, showing that simulation-oracle data alone can personalize VLA manipulation policies.
highlights_zh: 建筑级real-to-sim-to-real个性化VLA流水线
目标场景拾取成功率62.5%，真机63.9%
仅需手机扫描，但依赖仿真oracle数据

papers.title: Noise Space Learning for VLA Adaptation
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models encode broad manipulation priors, yet adapting them to specific tasks requires balancing limited robot interaction, computational resources, and safety constraints. Noise space learning (NSL) adapts flow-matching-based VLAs by learning a context-conditioned distribution over noise while keeping the pretrained VLA fixed. Building on prior noise-steering methods, we formulate NSL as an interface for VLA adaptation that accommodates different learning algorithms and instantiate it with PPO, SAC, and AWR. Theoretically, we provide an information-theoretic analysis of how NSL enables efficient adaptation. Empirically, we study these NSL algorithms on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and four real-robot manipulation tasks under interaction, computation, and execution constraints. Across these settings, we develop a suite of effective NSL variants and derive practical recommendations for choosing among them under different resource and deployment regimes.
papers.summary_zh: 预训练VLA模型虽具备广泛操作先验，但适应特定任务时需平衡有限交互、计算资源与安全约束。本文提出噪声空间学习（NSL），通过固定预训练VLA、学习上下文条件化的噪声分布，将NSL形式化为兼容PPO、SAC、AWR等算法的VLA适应接口，并给出信息论分析。在LIBERO、RoboTwin及四个真实机器人任务上，NSL在交互、计算与执行约束下均有效，并给出了不同资源与部署场景下的算法选择建议。
papers.summary_en: Pretrained VLA models encode broad manipulation priors, but adapting them to specific tasks must balance limited robot interaction, computation, and safety constraints. This paper proposes Noise Space Learning (NSL), which keeps the pretrained VLA fixed and learns a context-conditioned noise distribution, formalizing NSL as an adaptation interface compatible with PPO, SAC, and AWR, supported by an information-theoretic analysis. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and four real-robot tasks under interaction, computation, and execution constraints yield effective NSL variants and practical recommendations for algorithm selection across resource and deployment regimes.
highlights_zh: 固定VLA学习噪声分布，兼容多种RL算法
在LIBERO、RoboTwin及真机任务上验证有效
给出不同资源约束下的算法选择建议

papers.title: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
papers.abstract: Robot policies often convert sensing and control into fixed-rate observation-action sequences, leaving physical time implicit in sequence position. This assumption breaks when observation rates or delays vary, or when inference latency changes. We introduce Chronos Policy, which makes physical time explicit by conditioning on observation capture times and desired action execution times. We study two ways to incorporate time into a diffusion transformer: adding timestamp embeddings to token features, or encoding physical time in positional encoding through time-aware rotary positional encodings (time-aware RoPE). We find that time-aware RoPE is more robust, allowing attention to depend directly on physical time while keeping token content unchanged. During training, we temporally randomize which observations are sampled and when the action chunk begins, exposing the policy to a wider range of sensing and execution schedules that may occur during deployments. This also enables learning from asynchronous, multi-rate data without forcing all measurements onto a fixed temporal grid. Across simulation and real-world experiments, Chronos Policy improves performance on dynamic tasks, where observation-to-action timing is critical, and on multisensory tasks, where the relative timing between observations matters. On standard quasi-static tasks, it preserves nominal performance while improving robustness to changes in sensing and inference timing.
papers.summary_zh: 机器人策略通常将感知与控制建模为固定频率的观测-动作序列，使物理时间隐含在序列位置中，当观测频率、延迟或推理时延变化时该假设失效。Chronos Policy 通过以观测采集时间和期望动作执行时间为条件显式建模物理时间，并比较了时间戳嵌入与时间感知旋转位置编码（time-aware RoPE）两种方式，发现后者更鲁棒，同时在训练中对观测采样与动作块起始时间进行随机化以适配异步多速率数据。在仿真与真实实验中，该方法在动态任务和多感官任务上提升性能，在准静态任务上保持原有表现并增强对感知与推理时序变化的鲁棒性。
papers.summary_en: Robot policies typically cast sensing and control as fixed-rate observation-action sequences, leaving physical time implicit in sequence position, which breaks when observation rates, delays, or inference latency vary. Chronos Policy makes physical time explicit by conditioning on observation capture times and desired action execution times, comparing timestamp embeddings against time-aware rotary positional encodings (time-aware RoPE), with the latter proving more robust, while temporal randomization of observation sampling and action-chunk onset enables learning from asynchronous, multi-rate data. Across simulation and real-world experiments, it improves performance on dynamic and multisensory tasks, preserves nominal performance on quasi-static tasks, and enhances robustness to changes in sensing and inference timing.
highlights_zh: 显式物理时间条件化策略
动态与多感官任务性能提升
适配异步多速率数据
